description: This bar chart illustrates the CoLeG-R (%) performance across three LLaMA-2 model scales—LLaMA-2-7B, LLaMA-2-13B, and LLaMA-2-70B—under four different Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) conditions, as indicated by the legend: “no SFT” (light blue, diagonal stripes), “+ SFT on D₀” (light orange, horizontal stripes), “+ SFT on D₀, D₁” (light purple, diagonal stripes), and “+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂” (pink, solid fill). The vertical axis represents CoLeG-R (%) on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 80, with tick marks at intervals of 10. The horizontal axis lists the three model scales in left-to-right order. For each model scale, four bars are grouped side-by-side, each representing one SFT condition. The tallest bars, indicating the highest CoLeG-R scores, are consistently the pink bars (“+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂”), reaching approximately 83% for LLaMA-2-7B, 83% for LLaMA-2-13B, and 83% for LLaMA-2-70B. The shortest bars, representing “no SFT”, are the light blue bars, with values around 67% for LLaMA-2-7B, 70% for LLaMA-2-13B, and 80% for LLaMA-2-70B. The chart does not show any sorting of bars within each group or any visual emphasis such as shading or bolding beyond the distinct color and pattern coding for each SFT condition.
